data.body: CROSS_CUTTING_DESIGN (gap analysis on 982a): The 'reserved task-type namespace' pairing scheme has NO machine-readable persistence — task-decomposer's task_type enum is {code,recipe,docs,e2e,cleanup} and impl-plan Step 5 persists no role tag/field on created tickets, so a sprint-time consumer cannot deterministically pair sweep/verification (or rollback/rollback-verification, cutover/cleanup) halves. RESOLUTION (threaded via AC amendments): adopt a reserved PAIRING-TAG convention — emitter pair-half tasks carry a tag migration-role:<role> where role ∈ {automated-sweep, manual-verification, rollback, rollback-verification, flag-cutover, flag-cleanup}, written at ticket-create time; the 982a helper pairs halves by these tags (NOT by title prose). Emitter GREEN tasks (1c2b 71e4, ef21 ffec, c5fa d666) must specify emitting the role tag; 982a helper (c7fd) + suite (c388) pair via the tag. Document the convention in migration-class-marker.md (or a pairing contract).
